chapter: War years, Goodman and Woody Herman
title: Woody Herman as a leader
summary: Norvo found Woody easy-going and fatherly, and had known him since Woody romanced his wife at the Famous Door.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Yeah. Well you know, you were talking about believing in things, I mean that's --
That's right.
-- I mean that's the essence and that's what it was, wasn't it?
Right.

And in the best days of any great band, I mean the Fletcher Henderson band was the same thing. When a band -- when the time has come for a band, when it's that way and everybody's -- you know, there's a sense that you're really making history, which you are, really, in a sense. You
know you've got a joint thing going that's -- That's right.
-- that everybody's a part of. You know that must've been very enjoyable, I think. What's Woody like to -- to -- to work with?

Oh, really?
Yeah, Famous Door.
Oh, really?
Yeah, Famous Door with a big band.
